profiles.description: An illustrative propositional reading of the simplicity question. Atomic propositions concern the same subject and reading throughout.

definitions.description: The subject has the relevant kind of real relational distinction.

premises.statement: If the subject is simple, it has no metaphysical composition.
The relevant kind of real relational distinction entails metaphysical composition.
premises.support: disputed hypothetical premise used as a control

objections.statement: Whether these independent atomic propositions capture classical divine simplicity remains unresolved. A theological or metaphysical account might constrain their joint values.

arguments.warrant: Test whether the assumptions entail the absence of the relevant relational distinction.
Compose the exclusion of composition with the hypothetical bridge; the extra premise is explicit.
